description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Suriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/0075)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration particulars. It falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and cadastral matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
